messages:
ella-cs: quick heads-up — Horizon Sentinel onboarding: they want APAC + EU allowlist + temporary rate bump for a customer demo on 2026-04-02. Renewal conversation next week; customer said poor perf last month might affect renewal. Can ops/infra help with a short-lived ramp and allowlist?

devon-ops: noted. can you share CIDRs and expected QPS? also any mtls requirement?

ella-cs: CIDRs are 203.0.113.0/26 and 198.51.100.16/28. Estimated peak 250 qps for a 3-hour demo window (13:00–16:00 JST). No mTLS on their side for the demo, but they want header-whitelist for tracking.

sanjay-net: thanks. we can add both CIDR ranges to the egress allowlist. suggest temp-rate window + burst policy. who owns auto-revoke?

morgan-cs: I can confirm with the customer the exact time and get written confirmation for auto-revoke after the window. prefer auto-revoke at +6h post-window.

olivia-traffic: capacity check: current APAC pool headroom is ~1.6x for that time, but if we get concurrent demo spikes we should route non-critical traffic to EU fallback. propose policy: APAC primary, EU fallback with 60ms added latency tolerance.

devon-ops: config draft:
```
allowlist:{
  "customer":"horizon-sentinel",
  "cidrs":["203.0.113.0/26","198.51.100.16/28"],
  "regions":["ap-northeast-1","eu-west-1"],
  "window":"2026-04-02T04:00:00Z/2026-04-02T07:00:00Z",
  "auto_revoke":"6h"
}
rate_limit_override:{
  "peak_qps":250,
  "burst":400,
  "apply_to":"proxy-route:hs-demo",
  "rollback":"2026-04-02T13:10:00Z"
}
```

sanjay-net: look good. I will need an approval ticket to push CIDRs to the edge ACLs and update the routing policy. please ping @deploy-bot with the ticket id.

ella-cs: creating ticket now. note: they asked for header allowlist key X-Cust-Demo for tracing. add to ingress filters.

morgan-cs: added header note. i'll get signed approval email and drop it in the ticket.

deploy-bot: NOTE: automated preflight checks — APAC pool headroom OK, EU fallback capacity check OK, security scan requires mTLS opt-in confirmation for production (not required for demo).

olivia-traffic: one more: suggest enabling prefix KV cache warmup for their demo prompts to avoid cold-start latency. small script invocation on demo start should do it.

devon-ops: agreed. add cache_warmup:true in apply job. i'll schedule the change to go live 15m before window.

ella-cs: timeline: 2026-04-01 23:00 UTC — final ticket & approval in. 2026-04-02 03:45 UTC — changes applied, warmup run at 03:45. 04:00–07:00 UTC — demo window (JST afternoon). auto-revoke at 13:00 UTC.

morgan-cs: follow-up: i'll run a quick runbook with the customer for rollback steps and confirm renewal call availability the following day.

devon-ops: action items: 1) devon to stage ACL & routing policy, 2) sanjay to await deploy-bot approval and apply, 3) olivia to run KV warmup, 4) morgan to attach approval email.

ella-cs: thanks all — please update the ticket with status. i'll loop in account exec for renewal prep. :pray:
